display.purpose: The single hero h1. Anuphan for Thai (loopless), Plus Jakarta Sans for Latin.

headline.purpose: Every section h2. Four sections center theirs at max-width 720px.

title.purpose: Card and feature-panel h3. #why-us labels are the one exception at 600/1.02rem.

body.purpose: All running copy, Thai and English. Niramit for Thai (looped). Never below 18px/500.

label.purpose: .section-kicker above every h2. Slate Sage on light grounds, Mist or Editorial Pink on dark.

shadows.name: hairline
shadows.purpose: The default for every card, figure, feature panel, and price card below the hero. Reads as a printed edge, not a lifted object.

shadows.name: document-lift
shadows.purpose: The hero's primary .doc-card tax invoice. Representational — paper lying on a desk.

shadows.name: document-float
shadows.purpose: The five .doc-mini slips scattered around the hero card.

shadows.name: legacy-soft
shadows.purpose: DEPRECATED. The --shadow token from an earlier pass, still on .profile-panel and card hover. Replace with hairline outside the hero.

motion.name: ease-reveal
motion.purpose: The system curve. Nine entrance and reveal animations use it.

motion.name: ease-overshoot
motion.purpose: The hero .doc-stamp landing at 1.25s. The only overshoot in the system.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Button background change. Buttons never transform or gain shadow.

motion.name: state-standard
motion.purpose: Card hover, nav menu open, border and outline shifts.

motion.name: float-loop
motion.purpose: docCardFloat on the hero invoice; docMiniFloat runs 6.8s. Both disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The only element a visitor is invited to press. Flat burgundy, near-square, no gradient, no lift.
components.html: ปรึกษาฟรี
components.css: .ds-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 3px; background: #A63A56; color: #fff; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans','Anuphan',sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background .125s ease; } .ds-cta:hover { background: #7D2440; } .ds-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #A63A56; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined companion to the primary. Ink border on transparent, washes on hover.
components.css: .ds-cta-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 22px; border: 1px solid #10241F; border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: #10241F; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans','Anuphan',sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background .125s ease, border-color .125s ease; } .ds-cta-secondary:hover { background: rgba(1,47,42,.06); } .ds-cta-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #A63A56; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: White surface on ivory or cool-page ground. Hairline shadow at rest; a 3px accent bar fades in along the top edge on hover.
components.html:
รายงานภาษีซื้อ–ขาย

ภ.พ.30 พร้อมใบแนบ รองรับสำนักงานใหญ่และสาขา รวมถึงการแยกยื่นรายสาขา
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; overflow: hidden; padding: 28px; border: 1px solid #D9E4E3; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,.12), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.14); transition: transform .22s ease, border-color .22s ease, box-shadow .22s ease; } .ds-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 3px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #417771, #739B97); opacity: 0; transition: opacity .22s ease; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-5px); border-color: rgba(65,119,113,.32); } .ds-card:hover::before { opacity: 1; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 10px; color: #10241F; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans','Anuphan',sans-serif; font-size: 1.08rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -.025em; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: #5C736E; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans','Niramit',sans-serif; font-size: .95rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.7; text-wrap: pretty; } .ds-card p strong { color: #10241F; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Section Kicker
components.description: The small tracked label that sits above every section h2. Slate Sage on light grounds; Editorial Pink on dark.
components.css: .ds-kicker { margin: 0 0 8px; color: #5C736E; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans','Anuphan',sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .08em; }

components.name: Nav Contact CTA
components.description: The last link in the sticky nav and the only colored item in the bar. Everything else is ink on translucent white.
components.html: บริการราคาติดต่อ
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; padding: 10px 18px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.94); border-bottom: 1px solid #E2E8E6; } .ds-nav a { padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 3px; color: #10241F; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans','Anuphan',sans-serif; font-size: .9rem; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; transition: background .125s ease, color .125s ease; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #012F2A; background: rgba(1,47,42,.06); } .ds-nav .ds-nav-cta { background: #A63A56; color: #fff; } .ds-nav .ds-nav-cta:hover { background: #7D2440; color: #fff; }

components.name: Language Toggle
components.description: Two small outlined buttons in the nav. The active one fills Deep Teal — never burgundy, because switching language is not the action being sold.
components.css: .ds-lang { display: flex; gap: 2px; align-items: center; } .ds-lang button { padding: 4px 9px; border: 1px solid #E2E8E6; border-radius: 3px; background: transparent; color: #5C736E; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans','Anuphan',sans-serif; font-size: .85rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: color .18s ease, background .18s ease; } .ds-lang button:hover { background: rgba(1,47,42,.06); } .ds-lang button.on { color: #fff; background: #012F2A; border-color: #012F2A; } .ds-lang button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #A63A56; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Feature Tab
components.description: One of six tabs in #features that swap the localization proof panels. The page's main interactive proof surface.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-tabs button { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 18px; border: 1px solid #E2E8E6; border-radius: 3px; background: #fff; color: #5C736E; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans','Anuphan',sans-serif; font-size: .95rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background .125s ease, border-color .125s ease, color .125s ease; } .ds-tabs button:hover { color: #10241F; background: rgba(1,47,42,.06); } .ds-tabs button.is-on { color: #fff; background: #012F2A; border-color: #012F2A; } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #A63A56; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Document Stamp
components.description: The dashed burgundy stamp on the hero's CSS-drawn Thai tax invoice. Lands at 1.25s on the system's only overshoot curve.
components.html: ภ.พ.30 พร้อมยื่น
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-block; transform: rotate(-4deg); padding: 6px 12px; border: 2px dashed #A63A56; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.96); color: #7D2440; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans','Anuphan',sans-serif; font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px -8px rgba(7,45,48,.4); animation: ds-stampPop .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1.35) both; } @keyframes ds-stampPop { from { opacity: 0; transform: rotate(-4deg) scale(.7); } to { opacity: 1; transform: rotate(-4deg) scale(1); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-stamp { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
This is a Business Central screen that grew up and became a website. The visitor is an accountant or a finance lead who spends their working day inside Microsoft's ERP, and the page borrows that room's manners on purpose: square corners, hairline separators, a single saturated action color, and headings set at weight 500 rather than the heavy 700 that marketing pages default to. When someone who already runs BC lands here, the surface should feel like the same building — not like a startup selling to them.

The restraint is a credibility argument, not a stylistic preference. The practice sells one thing above all — a Thai localization package that already exists and already works — and the design's job is to make that claim look inspectable rather than promoted. Flat surfaces read as fact. Gradients, glows, and lifted cards read as sales. Everywhere the page has a choice, it takes the version that looks like documentation.

Warmth comes from two places only. The ivory paper tones (#EFEFE9, #fbf8f1) that carry the hero and every alternate section give the page the color of real accounting stock instead of the blue-white of a dashboard. And burgundy — a color no ERP vendor uses — is spent exclusively on the things a visitor is meant to touch. The deep teal family does the institutional work; burgundy does the asking.
keyCharacteristics: Square-cornered and flat: 3px buttons, 8px cards, hairline shadows
Ivory paper ground rather than blue-white dashboard ground
One action color (burgundy) against one institutional family (deep teal)
Headings at weight 500, tight tracking (-0.025em) — Fluent, not marketing
Thai body copy set at 18px/500 for sustained reading, never smaller
Microsoft's own brand hues appear only where Microsoft's own framework is being cited

rules.name: The Burgundy Toll Rule
rules.body: Burgundy is the price of asking for something. If an element does not want a click, it does not get burgundy — not as a border, not as an icon tint, not as a hover. The nav has exactly one burgundy item; the hero has exactly one; a section has at most one.

rules.name: The Quotation Rule
rules.body: The --ms-* hues are Microsoft's, borrowed to label Microsoft's own five-phase framework. They never leak into JWIC's own UI. If a new element needs a color and reaches for --ms-blue, it has misunderstood what that token is for.

rules.name: The Paper Rule
rules.body: Every surface is ivory, cool page, or white. Never a colored tint of the accent, never a blue-grey. The page is printed matter, not a screen.

rules.name: The Thai Weight Floor Rule
rules.body: Thai body text never goes below 18px/500. Thai glyphs at weight 400 read thin and tiring at the sizes Latin tolerates; the whole page was raised to 18/500 for this reason. A redesign that cleans up the type by dropping to 16px/400 has made the page worse for its actual readers.

rules.name: The Loop Contrast Rule
rules.body: Headings are loopless (Anuphan), body is looped (Niramit). Never set a Thai heading in Niramit or Thai body copy in Anuphan — the hierarchy is carried by loop, not by size.

rules.name: The No-Break Rule
rules.body: Thai has no inter-word spaces, so browsers break compound words mid-term. Wrap any term that must not split in .nb.

rules.name: The Right-Edge Bleed Rule
rules.body: The hero's color blocks are positioned with right: calc(50% - 50vw) so they run past the container to the viewport edge. They are hidden below 900px, where a single column would put them under the headline instead of beside it.

rules.name: The Hero-Only Lift Rule
rules.body: Soft wide shadows exist to say 'this is paper on a desk.' They belong to the hero document scene. A new card, panel, or price block gets the hairline. If a new element wants a big shadow, the honest question is whether it wants to be in the hero.

rules.name: The No Hover Lift Rule
rules.body: .cta explicitly kills transform and box-shadow on hover and changes background only, in 125ms. Buttons do not rise. Cards still lift 5px, which is a live inconsistency the system has not yet resolved.

rules.name: The Two Radii Rule
rules.body: New components use var(--ui-radius-btn) (3px) or var(--ui-radius-card) (8px). Do not introduce a third value. A literal border-radius: 14px in new code is a bug, not a choice.

dos: Do put new tokens in the last :root in the file — the --ui-* block (currently around line 2171). Being last is what makes it the one that wins; find it by searching --ui-radius-btn, not by line number.
Do use var(--ui-radius-btn) (3px) or var(--ui-radius-card) (8px) for every new corner.
Do give every new surface the Hairline shadow, and reach for a soft shadow only inside the hero document scene.
Do keep Thai body copy at 18px/500 and Thai headings in Anuphan.
Do wrap unbreakable Thai compounds in .nb.
Do update the I18N dictionary at the end of <script> whenever page text moves — especially nth-child selectors, which silently mistranslate when a sibling is inserted.
Do add a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce rule alongside any new animation.
Do keep the burgundy CTA the single loudest thing in any viewport.
donts: Don't add a fifth :root block. There are already four (currently around lines 155, 762, 1577, 2171) and three of them are mostly dead. New work consolidates; it does not stack.

Don't trust a color you read in the first :root. --navy: #0D5257 and --muted: #0f4a52 there are overridden and never render. The live values come from the --brand-* block and the --ui-* block that follow it — read both before quoting any value.
Don't put a gradient on a button. .cta strips background-image with !important precisely because earlier layers added them.
Don't let a button lift or glow on hover. Background change only, 125ms.
Don't spend burgundy on anything that isn't asking for a click.
Don't use the --ms-* hues outside the five Success by Design stage labels.
Don't introduce a new radius value. The long tail of 9/12/14/16/18/20/22/24/28px is debt, not vocabulary.

Don't put a gradient back on header. The hero ground is flat Paper Ivory (#EFEFE9). A multi-stop teal gradient and its --hero-deep / --hero-mid / --hero-end tokens lived here for a while, overridden and never rendering; they have been deleted.
Don't add a new !important. The existing ones are documented specificity fights; each new one makes the next change harder.
Don't move or rename a file. Every committed path is a live URL that may already have been shared.
